title: Nichtlineare Optimierung (TUM, Modul MA3503)
description: At the end of the module students are able to understand optimization theory in detail, to understand advanced theoretical and numerical aspects of modern nonlinear optimization, to assess and investigate the convergence properties of optimization methods and to apply optimization theory and methods. 5 ECTS, angeboten im Wintersemester, Version 2023s, verantwortet von Ulbrich, Michael.
